name: Tsui no Yakata ~Koibumi~
source:
Released under the Circus brand division 'Circus Fetish', the Tsui no Yakata series mainly focuses on maids.

The first game in the Tsui no Yakata series, tells the story of second lieutenant Mori, a wounded soldier returning from a war in Russia.
translation:
《终之馆》系列由CIRCUS旗下品牌分部“CIRCUS Fetish”发行，主要围绕女仆展开。

系列第一作讲述森少尉的故事。他是一名在对俄战争中负伤后归来的军人。
